svg.text: Uprights: 10 thick, at Z = 20–30 and Z = 50–60. Arm (18 thick) is centered between them (Z = 31–49).
Pin: Ø12 × 40, ends flush with the outer upright faces. The near upright hides the arm's pivot end in FRONT.
Q12: θ = 30° Q13: θ = 60° (θ measured from +X, arm points up and right)
Units: MMGS. Mates: plate fixed; uprights, pin and arm located as dimensioned; pin and arm holes concentric.
